ValidationRule.description: The order form strips everything but letters, digits, hyphen and underscore before looking a code up, so a code stored with a space or punctuation can never be matched. Saving one produces a code nobody can redeem, so it is refused here instead.
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Code may only contain letters, numbers, hyphens and underscores (no spaces or punctuation), and must be 40 characters or fewer.
